records.scenarioAlias: DDP-SC-06
dependencies: T025 completed engineering receipt checked by coordinator
records.positiveCriterion: Core/service/real-stdio parity receipts, exact expected tree, cleanup and source-immutability checks. T024 corpus replay only if separately authorized as software integration regression; never new accuracy. Local bounded stage receipts include acquisition, IR, verifier, selection, tree build, revalidation, fresh native proof, prepare/reverification, transport/evidence validation and cleanup, with measured outer total and null unknowns. Numeric envelope and enforcement mode must be explicit before closure. No cache reuse without separately reviewed freshness/binding/invalidation contract.

Decision expiry prevents prepare; remaining prepare budget cannot reset; cancellation suppresses late result and proves cleanup/termination or records enforcement unsupported; stale observation/proof reuse refuses.
